It was quite surprising seeing the credit list and finding out that Ed Asner and Ford Rainey were in the production somewhere. The acting ranges from Very good to shaky, and the script sometimes can't veer above soap opera level. (The discussion which the new girl has with her family is pretty bad, as both actors seem to have arrived from a road production of 'Lilies Of The Field'. All in all, an 'important' film I'm sure for it's time, but…

TinSoldier: A beautiful and touching story based on Hans Christian Andersen's fairy tale "The Steadfast Tin Soldier". A tin soldier without a leg sees a beautiful paper ballerina and falls in love. While trying to reach her, he falls from the window and has to overcome countless obstacles to see her again.

rv: A Classic Tale Of Love & Heartbreak

This beautiful classic cartoon is based on the French play "La Tosca", written by Victorien Sardou, and premiered in Paris on 24 November 1887. In the story "La Tosca", a poor artist falls in love with a beautiful prostitute. When the local magistrate discovers their secret love, he becomes jealous and wants Tosca for himself. Out of his jealousy, the artist is arrested & sentenced to death. The only way the magistrate will allow the artist to live is if Tosca vows her loyalty & love to him instead. Although she agrees, to save the life of her artist love, the magistrate has his put to death…

a-cosmic-christmas-special: A Cosmic Christmas is a 1977 American-Canadian Christmas animated television special, premiering on CBC in Canada and in syndication in the United States on 4 December 1977. It premiered on 4 December 1977 on CBC Television.

and.-then.-there.-were.-none.-1945: And Then There Were None is a 1945 film adaptation of Agatha Christie's 1939 mystery novel of the same name, directed by René Clair. In the film, ten strangers are invited to a remote island by a mysterious host, Mr. and Mrs. Owen, who do not appear. As they settle in, they are accused of past murders and begin to be killed off one by one, leading the survivors to realize that the killer is among them.
